scenario: [RLOW.6.1.10]: a non-base assertion is an operation and not a read of its operand, so it does not stand as a slot in a join anchor. Under `linear_scan: false`, two `logical` schemas keyed on a `Float` slot, joined only by `a.k::km == b.k::km`: the equality is over two conversions, so no `key` slot is pinned, and the rule is refused as unanchored. Both sides are asserted so the comparison is same-dimension and the anchor refusal is the only one. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.slot_equality`, which accepts only a slot read on each side, reached from `anchor_body`'s last arm.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

unit km: length = x * 1000

schema A scope logical:
    k: Float key
    v: Int mutable

schema B scope logical:
    k: Float key
    w: Int mutable

rule joined:
    A a
    B b where a.k::km == b.k::km
->
    log info "x"
